args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified. Root cause of v2.3.1 health-check failures still needs investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api: current version v2.3.1 was unhealthy (error rate ~18%) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 — the most recent healthy production release — across all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0, and paged the on-call engineer.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 health-check failures still needs investigation, which I've flagged in the incident summary.
